review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Tasks, Responsibilities, and Duties: Assess, implement, and maintain converged network infrastructure to facilitate seamless communication and integration between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) systems. • Monitor network performance and security, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to ensure the reliability and integrity of converged OT-IT networks. • Manage network device configurations, security measures, and documentation to maintain compliance with i
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: • Manage network device configurations, security measures, and documentation to maintain compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements. • Engage with network equipment vendors and service providers to procure hardware, software, and services that support the requirements of converged OT-IT environments. • Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience). • 2 years of experience in installation, configuration, and technical support for firewall solutions, with demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and managing complex network environments. Proficiency in networking technologies and protocols, including routing, switching, TCP/IP, VLANs, and VPNs. • Hands-on experience with network security measures, including Fortinet / Palo Alto firewalls.
